pa-dos-2026-electioninfo.title: PA Voter Services, Election Information: 2026 General Election
pa-dos-2026-electioninfo.note: Read from the page's own candidate data: 477 rows for Governor, Lieutenant Governor and both chambers of the General Assembly (50 federal (the federal pages), 775 party office rows not read). The November ballot is every Approved candidate who came by nomination papers or won the May 19 primary (by petition, by write-in votes, or as the party's substitute). Only candidate id, name, party, status, how the candidate got there, office, district and primary result are kept; the residence columns are dropped as the page is read. Names are turned first name first and into ordinary capitals. The list gives no ballot positions.

pa-dos-returns-election-list.title: Pennsylvania Election Returns: election list
pa-dos-returns-election-list.note: Read only for the status of the 2026 General Primary (election 117): Official (ElectionStatus O), so its returns are stored.

pa-dos-2026-primary-governor.title: Pennsylvania Election Returns: 2026 General Primary (May 19, 2026), Governor, Official Returns
pa-dos-2026-primary-governor.note: Statewide total of every printed candidate in each party's primary, read from the data call the Office Results page makes (https://www.electionreturns.pa.gov/api/ElectionReturn/GetOfficeData?officeId=3&methodName=GetOfficeDetails&electionid=117&electiontype=P&isactive=0). Election-day, mail and provisional votes add up to each total. The returns carry no write-in votes, so percentages are of the printed candidates' votes; who advanced is the candidate list's primary result, checked against the top vote-getter.
